title: Prescribed-qbot exact-retention paired timing matrix
question: Across the full qualified prescribed-qbot matrix, does authoritative theta/C plus selected K lookup provide a consistent complete-Richards CPU benefit over the fully analytical provider?
fidelity_precondition: F-AHL21H 12/12 PASS with identical nonlinear iteration and backtracking path.

timing_policy.compiler: gfortran -O3 without runtime checks or floating-point traps
timing_policy.order: alternate analytical->candidate and candidate->analytical by repetition

decision_rule: Retain partial qbot acceleration only if it is positive in most cases and introduces no materially negative cases; otherwise prefer fully analytical hydraulics for prescribed-qbot as the simpler bounded route.
